subject: Governance trimming proposal + QBR action items
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: partners-team@consultco.com, Nora Klein <nora@brightlane.ai>
Date: 2027-10-05T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Governance trimming proposal + QBR action items

Team —

Following our ops review, I attached a short proposal (governance-proposal-v2.pdf) to simplify our pillar governance ahead of the QBR. High level: reduce active pillars from six to four, consolidate two cross-functional leads into a single platform lead, and shorten required governance reviews from monthly to biweekly for the first 90 days. Rationale: speed up decision cadence for infra and runtime priorities, reduce duplicate work across squads, and make escalation paths clearer.

Key asks for this week (timing = before Friday EOD):
- Read the attached proposal and flag any critical blockers or omissions.
- Confirm the QBR slide owner for each remaining pillar (I attached qbr-slide-owners.xlsx to capture owners).
- If you believe your org needs a carve-out for any retained pillar, mark it in the spreadsheet and include a 2–3 line justification.

Why now: we need a concise comms plan for the exec readout and to lock OKR owners so product metrics can be pulled for the QBR deck. I danbled a first-draft comms outline in comm-draft-for-review.docx — happy to hand this to Marissa for polishing.

Early concerns I'm aware of: headcount alignment and temporary role consolidation for two lead PMs. If we proceed, we should present the QBR with a clear, time-boxed change (pilot window + review).

Please reply with confirmations or major objections by Friday 5pm PT. If you can't make that deadline, say so and give an ETA. I'll synth a final proposal and a short leadership talking script after we close comments.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: governance-proposal-v2.pdf, qbr-slide-owners.xlsx, comm-draft-for-review.docx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Governance trimming proposal + QBR action items

Tessa —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick read-through notes below; I'll add comments in the PDF as well.

- Strong +1 on reducing pillars for clarity. Please add a short table that maps old pillars -> new pillars (one row per change) so the execs can quickly see the delta.
- We should call out the measurement plan for the first 30/60/90 days (what metric signals success/failure). That will prevent this looking like a headcount cut without measurable outcomes.
- Timeline: If we finalize by Friday, I recommend a dry-run of the QBR talking points on Monday morning for the execs.

On the spreadsheet: I can own the Runtime pillar slides (I'll update the owner cell). Marissa, can you confirm Platform & Developer Experience ownership?

Small edits inline — nothing that blocks your Friday deadline, but we should be disciplined about the pilot window and retro date.

Appreciate the draft, Tessa. I reviewed and added a couple of practical concerns:

- Platform lead consolidation: operationally this is feasible for a 90-day pilot if we tie it to a single decision owner and an SLA for escalations. I'll draft the escalation flow in the comm doc (attaching comm-draft-for-review.docx with my edits).
- People impact: we should avoid surprises. Suggest we prepare a pre-brief script for any managers who will be affected and include HR in the final comms loop (I can coordinate with HR once we lock owners).
- QBR slides: I'll take the comms + slide layout ownership and will align with Jonas on the Runtime material.

Marissa

Subject: Re: Governance trimming proposal + QBR action items — agreed next steps

Thanks all for the fast turn. Summary & agreed next steps: 

Decisions agreed (for the pilot window):
- Active pillars reduced to four (Platform, Runtime, Product Core, GTM).
- Platform lead consolidation approved for a 90-day pilot; escalation flow to be documented.
- Measurement plan: Jonas to own 30/60/90 metrics; template in the Drive link below.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Marissa: finalize comms draft + pre-brief script for managers — due Tue 2027-10-12 EOD. (Attachment: comm-draft-for-review.docx)
- Jonas: update qbr-slide-owners.xlsx with slide owners and 30/60/90 metrics — due Fri 2027-10-08 EOD.
- Tessa: prepare short leadership talking script and finalize the exec-facing one-pager — due Mon 2027-10-11 9am PT.
- Vivek & Laura: review proposed scale/backfill plan and provide headcount delta estimate — due Wed 2027-10-13 EOD.

I'll synth a single slide and a one-pager for the exec readout after your updates. We will do a dry run on Mon 2027-10-18 8:30am PT (please block).

Drive links: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1GOVERNANCE_PROPOSAL_V2 (proposal), https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/QBR_SLIDE_OWNERS

If any big objections surface over the weekend, escalate directly to me and cc Jonas. Otherwise I'll treat this as approved for the pilot and proceed with the readout materials.

Best,
Tessa
Director, Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference
